LEANIX_WORKSPACE_ID.description: Optional LeanIX workspace identifier (uuid4 or tenant-scoped slug like 'acme-prod') forwarded server-side as the workspaceId query param on GET /services/pathfinder/v1/factSheets. Defence-in-depth — the LEANIX_API_TOKEN's scope already determines which workspace it sees; this param locks the call onto a specific workspace when the token is multi-workspace. Found in the LeanIX console URL bar (the workspace slug appears between the host and /factsheet/) or via GET /services/mtm/v1/workspaces. The executor hard-validates the identifier shape client-side (alphanumeric + ._- up to 64 chars) so a typo or control char can't fan out into '/services/pathfinder/v1/factSheets?workspaceId=<garbage>' calls. Blank / missing falls back to the token's natural scope.

LEANIX_FACTSHEET_TYPE.description: Optional LeanIX factSheet type filter forwarded server-side as the factSheetType query param on GET /services/pathfinder/v1/factSheets. Accepts PascalCase alphanumeric type names — Application / BusinessCapability / ITComponent / Project / DataObject / Interface / TechnicalStack / Provider / UserGroup / etc. The executor hard-validates the type-name shape client-side (PascalCase alphanumeric up to 64 chars) so a typo or control char can't fan out into a 400. Blank / missing fans out across all factSheet types in the workspace.

name: leanix_eam
title: LeanIX EAM
description: LeanIX EAM (Enterprise Architecture Management, now SAP LeanIX) asset-inventory importer. Pulls factSheet records (Application / BusinessCapability / ITComponent / Project / DataObject / Interface / TechnicalStack / etc.) from a LeanIX EAM tenant via GET <LEANIX_HOST>/services/pathfinder/v1/factSheets and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON. Each LeanIX factSheet becomes one Faraday host (synthetic 0.0.0.0 — factSheets are identity-keyed EAM CMDB entries, not network endpoints) with host.os carrying the factSheet type label (e.g. 'LeanIX Application') and host.hostnames carrying the displayName / fullName pivots so Faraday's hostname index still surfaces the entry. The factSheet itself becomes one Faraday vulnerability with the [ASSET-INVENTORY] engine prefix so the data lands alongside the other CMDB-class feeds in `asset-inventory` (Armis / Axonius / Device42 / Fleet / Jamf Pro / Jira Insight / runZero). Severity is always `info` because LeanIX factSheets are inventory entries, not vulnerability findings — operators correlate against the EDR / EASM / vuln-scanner agents' findings via the LeanIX-Id / LeanIX-FactSheet refs. Pagination uses LeanIX's cursor-based pageSize + pageToken (PAGE_SIZE=100 per page capped at MAX_PAGES=200 = 20k records per scan). Auth: LeanIX EAM issues per-workspace API tokens via the LeanIX console under Administration -> Technical Users. The dispatcher exchanges LEANIX_API_TOKEN for a short-lived OAuth2 bearer at POST <LEANIX_HOST>/services/mtm/v1/oauth2/token using HTTP Basic with 'apitoken' as the username + the API token as the password and grant_type=client_credentials on the form-encoded body, then carries the returned access_token on every subsequent /services/pathfinder/ call as Authorization: Bearer <access_token>. LEANIX_HOST is optional — defaults to the canonical SaaS host https://app.leanix.net; tenant-specific subdomains (https://<tenant>.leanix.net) and EU / US-region / on-prem deployments override the host (hard-validated client-side as http(s)://host[:port], trailing slash stripped, control chars rejected). Refs include LeanIX-Id / LeanIX-FactSheet / LeanIX-Workspace / LeanIX-Status / LeanIX-Completion / LeanIX-Level / LeanIX-Category / LeanIX-SubType / LeanIX-Tags / LeanIX-TechnicalSuitability / LeanIX-BusinessCriticality / LeanIX-FunctionalFit pivots plus the canonical LeanIX factSheet permalink (https://<host>/<workspace>/factsheet/<id>) so operators can pivot from the Faraday vuln straight into the LeanIX console. CVE list harvested via a strict CVE-\d{4}-\d+ regex from cve / cveId / cves fields plus name / displayName / description / technicalDescription token scans (LeanIX factSheets don't carry CVEs natively but technical-stack / interface / IT-component records sometimes carry CVE refs in the freeform description text). Tags: [leanix, asset-inventory, leanix-eam, <factsheet-type-lower>].
